title: Where Position Matters: Profiling-Guided Layer-Wise RoPE Allocation in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.39223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) typically uses uniform coverage across Transformer layers despite heterogeneous positional requirements. Phase-off interventions reveal non-uniform, model-specific rotary-phase dependence, while coverage interventions relate it to coverage-upgrade benefits. We propose profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation, assigning high/low coverage under a fixed budget using early coverage-benefit profiles. The framework supports fixed-width query/key representations and physical rotary-dimension allocation in Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). Normalized-depth mapping transfers profiles within model families, enabling small-model measurements to guide larger-model allocations before pretraining. A brief analysis relates selection and transfer to score calibration and inter-layer interactions. translated_title: 位置在何处起作用：Transformer中基于剖析引导的逐层RoPE分配
translated_abstract: 旋转位置编码（RoPE）通常在各Transformer层使用统一的覆盖范围，尽管各层的位置需求存在异构性。关闭相位的干预实验揭示了非均匀的、模型特定的旋转相位依赖性，而覆盖干预实验则将其与覆盖升级收益联系起来。我们提出基于剖析引导的逐层RoPE分配方法，在固定预算下利用早期覆盖收益剖析为各层分配高/低覆盖。该框架支持多头潜在注意力（MLA）中的固定宽度查询/键表示以及物理旋转维度分配。归一化深度映射可在模型家族内迁移剖析结果，使小模型的测量结果能够在大模型预训练之前指导其分配方案。简要分析将选择与迁移机制同分数校准及层间交互联系起来。从头训练的实验表明，与现有的预算匹配基线相比，该方法在验证损失上取得了改进。
tldr: 提出基于剖析引导的逐层RoPE分配方法，通过小模型的早期覆盖收益剖析在固定预算下为大模型各层差异化分配旋转位置编码覆盖，从而降低验证损失。
en_tdlr: Proposes profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation that uses early coverage-benefit profiles from small models to assign high/low rotary position embedding coverage across Transformer layers under a fixed budget, improving validation loss over budget-matched baselines.
